summary.headline: ECOPRO BM's subsidiary ECOPRO Global Investment approves rights offering of KRW 622bn
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, the board of ECOPRO GLOBAL INVESTMENT PTE.LTD., a subsidiary of ECO PRO BM CO.,LTD., resolved a rights offering of 596,750,130 common shares at KRW 1,042.62 per share, with payment scheduled for Jun 30, 2027. The offering is a shareholder allotment (rights offering) and the proceeds are to be used for acquiring a stake in the PT BNSI smelter and securing shareholder loans. This filing replaces the subsidiary's rights offering disclosure submitted on Nov 10, 2026, reflecting a change in investment plans.

key_numbers.label: New common shares to be issued

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a rights offering by a subsidiary typically means new shares are offered to existing shareholders at a set price, and the parent company's ownership and funding of the subsidiary can change depending on whether shareholders subscribe. Filings like this are generally made so investors can track how a group is raising and deploying capital through its subsidiaries.
